from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from time import perf_counter

import requests
from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model

from apps.account.interface.authentication import TerminalInternalAuthentication

owner = get_user_model().objects.select_related("account_profile").get(pk=1)
assert owner.username == "admin" and owner.is_active and owner.is_staff and owner.is_superuser
assert owner.account_profile.mcp_enabled
secret = settings.AGOMTRADEPRO_INTERNAL_AUTH_SECRET
assert isinstance(secret, str) and secret.strip(), "Existing internal authentication is unavailable"
origin = "https://demo.agomtrade.pro"
results = []
for path in ("/api/tui/screens/execution.audit/", "/api/audit/tui/overview/"):
    started = perf_counter()
    timestamp = str(int(time.time()))
    payload = TerminalInternalAuthentication._build_signature_payload(
        timestamp=timestamp, method="GET", path=path,
        user_id=str(owner.pk), username=owner.username,
    )
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), payload.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    headers = {"X-Agom-Internal-Timestamp": timestamp,
        "X-Agom-Internal-User-Id": str(owner.pk),
        "X-Agom-Internal-Username": owner.username,
        "X-Agom-Internal-Signature": signature,
        "X-Agom-Internal-Source": "goal-aud03-readonly"}
    response = requests.get(origin + path, headers=headers, timeout=20, allow_redirects=False)
    entry = {"path": path, "status_code": response.status_code,
        "content_type": response.headers.get("Content-Type"),
        "elapsed_seconds": perf_counter() - started,
        "response_completed_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "raw_http_body_sha256": hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest()}
    if response.status_code == 200:
        payload = response.json()
        entry["response_top_level_keys"] = sorted(payload)
        if path.startswith("/api/tui/"):
            entry["screen_contract"] = {key: payload.get(key) for key in (
                "key", "screen_key", "title", "primary_task", "primary_outcome", "default_action_key"
            ) if key in payload}
            for key in ("screen", "spec", "ui_spec"):
                value = payload.get(key)
                if isinstance(value, dict):
                    entry[key + "_keys"] = sorted(value)
                    entry[key + "_contract"] = {name: value.get(name) for name in (
                        "key", "screen_key", "title", "primary_task", "primary_outcome", "default_action_key"
                    ) if name in value}
            actions = payload.get("actions", [])
            if isinstance(actions, list):
                entry["actions"] = [{key: action.get(key) for key in (
                    "key", "label", "endpoint", "method", "audience"
                )} for action in actions if isinstance(action, dict)]
        else:
            entry["overview_summary"] = {key: payload.get(key) for key in (
                "success", "report_total_count", "completed_backtest_count"
            )}
    results.append(entry)
print(json.dumps({
    "operation": "AUD-03 actual admin-authenticated TUI read contracts",
    "origin": origin,
    "identity": {"user_id": owner.pk, "username": owner.username,
        "active": owner.is_active, "staff": owner.is_staff, "superuser": owner.is_superuser},
    "authentication": "Existing TerminalInternalAuthentication HMAC contract, using server-configured secret and actual designated admin record. No key/signature is retained.",

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from time import perf_counter

import requests
from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model

from apps.account.interface.authentication import TerminalInternalAuthentication
from apps.terminal.application.repository_provider import get_tui_metadata_repository
from apps.terminal.application.tui_workbench import TuiWorkbenchService

owner = get_user_model().objects.select_related("account_profile").get(pk=1)
assert owner.username == "admin" and owner.is_active and owner.is_staff and owner.is_superuser
assert owner.account_profile.mcp_enabled
service = TuiWorkbenchService(metadata_repository=get_tui_metadata_repository())
action = service._action_by_key("audit.health-summary", user=owner)
assert action is not None and action["risk"] == "read" and action.get("effect", "read") == "read"
assert action["method"] == "GET" and action["endpoint"] == "/api/audit/health/"
path = "/api/tui/actions/audit.health-summary/run/"
timestamp = str(int(time.time()))
secret = settings.AGOMTRADEPRO_INTERNAL_AUTH_SECRET
assert isinstance(secret, str) and secret.strip()
signed = TerminalInternalAuthentication._build_signature_payload(
    timestamp=timestamp, method="POST", path=path, user_id=str(owner.pk), username=owner.username,
)
headers = {"X-Agom-Internal-Timestamp": timestamp,
    "X-Agom-Internal-User-Id": str(owner.pk), "X-Agom-Internal-Username": owner.username,
    "X-Agom-Internal-Signature": hmac.new(secret.encode(), signed.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(),
    "X-Agom-Internal-Source": "goal-aud03-readonly"}
started = perf_counter()
response = requests.post("https://demo.agomtrade.pro" + path, headers=headers,
    json={"params": {}, "confirmed": False}, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False)
result = {"operation": "Actual admin TUI default read-action execution",
    "identity": {"user_id": owner.pk, "username": owner.username},
    "action": {key: action.get(key) for key in ("key", "risk", "effect", "method", "endpoint")},
    "outer_transport": "POST TUI run with params={}, confirmed=false; verified inner action GET read",
    "status_code": response.status_code, "content_type": response.headers.get("Content-Type"),
    "response_completed_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "elapsed_seconds": perf_counter() - started,
    "raw_http_body_sha256": hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest(),
    "response": response.json(),
    "limits": ["Read-action execution may record normal terminal operational audit; it does not dispatch the System Audit outbox.",
        "No approval, proposal, AI model, billing, fault injection or runtime activation.",
        "Actual TUI runtime API flow, not browser visual verification or full AUD-03 acceptance."]}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
